IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Monday 2 November
Winds: Southerly below 10 knots.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy.

Tuesday 3 November
Winds: Southeast to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots tending southeasterly in the early afternoon then becoming variable below 10 knots in the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Wednesday 4 November
Winds: Variable below 10 knots becoming west to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 0.5 metres.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 90% chance of showers.

Thursday 5 November
Winds: Westerly 10 to 15 knots tending southwesterly during the day then turning northwesterly during the afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Friday 6 November
Winds: Northwesterly 10 to 15 knots tending westerly 15 to 20 knots during the morning.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 80% chance of showers.
IDT12420.synoptic: A low pressure system is forecast to move across Victoria today, before moving over the Tasman Sea tomorrow. A cold front is expected to move across Tasmania from the west on Wednesday followed by a more significant cold front during the day Friday.
